scripts.format: prettier --write src index.html package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts svelte.config.js scripts
scripts.desktop: npm run build && node scripts/rust.mjs run -p service-workspace
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && node scripts/rust.mjs build -p service-workspace --release
scripts.release:windows: npm run build && npx tauri build --bundles nsis && node scripts/package-windows.mjs
scripts.package:windows: npm run build && npm test && node scripts/rust.mjs build -p service-workspace && npm run test:native && npx tauri build --bundles nsis && node scripts/package-windows.mjs
